condo: 1KM To Boon Keng MRT Only! Below Valuation! Almost Sold!

history.summary: A 1,410 sqft 999-year 3BR in D12 (near Boon Keng) at $1.89M ($1,340 PSF). The clickbait listing title ('Below Valuation! Almost Sold!') and complete absence of URA appreciation/txn data make this a low-information entry that must be judged on fundamentals alone.
history.rating_rationale: 999-year tenure (near-freehold) and a fair $1,340 PSF for a roomy 1,410 sqft 3BR in city-fringe D12 are positives, and the $1.89M price sits in the liquid sweet spot. But the dossier has zero URA appreciation/txn data, the project isn't even named (listing title is a marketing slogan), and 710m to Boon Keng (NE9) is a 9-min walk. 2005 vintage means a 20-year-old block. Without a project identity to research, this stays a hold-grade Neutral.
red_flags: No URA appreciation or transaction data at all
Project name unidentifiable from listing — pure marketing title
9-min walk to MRT, not truly MRT-adjacent
catalysts: Reasonable $1,340 PSF for large 3BR in city-fringe D12
